competing_explanation: Agreement may arise from shared RGB-MSE/projection definitions, synthetic-image content, tiling, or official-model calibration rather than a haze-specific causal mechanism or deployment-predictable risk signal.
controls: exact parent split PASS identity, authorization, assignment digest, and 100-scene count
exact isolated asset counts of 400 haze and 400 exact-name clear files grouped into 100 scenes with four variants each
candidate-confirmation asset absent from the asset manifest and runtime context
synthetic unchanged, exact-GT, partial-recovery, strong-overshoot, Wilson-direction, and bootstrap-direction reference cases
strict official checkpoint load, frozen parameters, finite three-scale forward, and zero training
scene-level aggregation; tiles and variants never count as independent groups
disabled_actions: delivering or accessing the 150-scene candidate-confirmation asset
training, fitting, threshold adaptation, proxy selection, structure selection, or oracle execution
claiming paired input error is pure haze density or deployment-available
claiming signed projection proves perceptual over-dehazing or causality
treating tiles, variants, or clear aliases as independent groups
automatically continuing into an oracle, NH-HAZE audit, proxy, or module

gates.estimand: parent authorization, exact isolated role, 100 complete scenes, 400 finite inferences, no candidate-confirmation asset, and no training
lower 95 percent Wilson bound for globally improved scenes
lower Wilson bound for scene-level high-demand material signed overshoot
upper Wilson bound for scene-level high-demand under-recovery
upper paired-bootstrap bound for high-minus-low material overshoot fraction
lower Wilson bound for any strict stable local error; this gate selects the authorized next stage separately from pattern replication

fixed_factors: only the isolated 100-scene development_screening asset is delivered; the 150-scene candidate_confirmation asset is absent
official ConvIR-B base graph with 8,630,665 frozen parameters and strict checkpoint load
canonical scene SHA-256 over clear width, height, and decoded RGB bytes
split salt haze4k-test-local-error-replication-v1 and assignment digest 6ca5174470dad2b4eef4ae15c5a13a99d8ae9fc0bc2ea1116b199c4d4bc05582
32-by-32 nonoverlapping tiles with bottom-right reflection padding
paired input-versus-GT RGB MSE ranks lowest and highest 20 percent tile regions
under-recovery requires alpha at most 0.80 and output-to-input error ratio at least 0.25 in high-demand tiles
signed overshoot requires alpha at least 1.05 and projected magnitude at least 1/255
low-demand harm requires error ratio at least 1.10 and MSE increase at least squared 1/255
a scene-level replication construct uses the mean tile fraction across four variants and a 20 percent material threshold
a strict stable construct is variant-material in at least three of four variants
20,000 paired scene bootstrap resamples with seed 20260724
intervention.matched_budget: one frozen official ConvIR-B inference for each of 400 nested variants, zero training steps
intervention.reference: SOTS signed-overshoot and demand-specificity development evidence under the same 32-pixel tile, paired-demand, alpha, and projected-margin definitions

primary_estimand.aggregation: four variants summarized within canonical scene followed by equal-weight Wilson or paired scene-bootstrap inference across 100 scenes
primary_estimand.metric: joint scene-level evidence that high-demand signed overshoot lower 95 percent bound is at least 0.05, high-demand under-recovery upper bound is below 0.20, and high-minus-low overshoot upper bootstrap bound is below 0.05

question: On the isolated 100-scene Haze4K official-test development partition, does fixed official ConvIR-B reproduce the SOTS pattern of material signed overshoot without prevalent high-demand under-recovery or high-demand-specific overshoot, and are stable local errors prevalent enough to qualify a bounded non-deployable action oracle?

uncertainty.method: two-sided 95 percent Wilson intervals for scene prevalences and paired 20,000-resample bootstrap over canonical scenes for the high-minus-low contrast
